Run the node
Usage: telcoin node [OPTIONS]
Options:
  -d, --datadir <DATADIR>              The path to the data dir
      --log.stdout.format <FORMAT>     Log format
      --http                           Enable the HTTP-RPC server
      --http.addr <HTTP_ADDR>          Http server address
      --ws                             Enable the WS-RPC server
      --ws.addr <WS_ADDR>              Ws server address
      --healthcheck <ADDR>             Healthcheck listener
      --metrics <SOCKET>               Enable Prometheus metrics
